opening.argument: The video establishes that the purported Chipotle reward is not a genuine $100 gift-card offer: it states, "Chipotle is not offering free $100 gift cards for National Avocado Day to internet users who share a link with their friends." The accompanying discussion identifies the gift-card graphic, sharing request, survey, and possible costly sign-up as features of a scam pattern, while noting that the fake offer appeared alongside a legitimate promotion. That genuine promotion offered free guacamole with an online or in-app order using the code AVOCADO, clearly distinguishing it from the purported gift-card scheme.

citations.quote: Chipotle is not offering free $100 gift cards for National Avocado Day to internet users who share a link with their friends.
